steps.summary: Created new contact 'fwod17-n2 Bench Customer' with City 'Benchville' in the Sales app's Customers section. Verified that no duplicate existed first. After saving, the contact form displays Name = "fwod17-n2 Bench Customer" and City = "Benchville".

Created quotation S00022 for 'fwod17-n2 Bench Customer'. Added order line with product "Customizable Desk" (selected from autocomplete), set Quantity to 3. The app auto-filled Unit Price at 750.00, computed Untaxed Amount as £ 2,250.00. Quotation was saved with reference S00022 — did not confirm it. All values verified from the live form.

Quotation S00022 has 2 order lines. Line 1: product "Customizable Desk", quantity 3.00, unit price 750.00, subtotal £ 2,250.00. Line 2: product "Conference Chair", quantity 2.00, unit price 33.00, subtotal £ 66.00. Total Untaxed Amount: £ 2,250.00. All values read from the live form.

Changed the first order line's Quantity from 3 to 5 on Quotation S00022 (customer fwod17-n2 Bench Customer). The line now shows: Customizable Desk, Qty 5.00, Unit Price 750.00, subtotal £3,750.00. The Untaxed Amount in the totals section is now £3,750.00. The second line (Conference Chair) was left untouched.

Confirmed quotation S00022 (customer fwod17-n2 Bench Customer). The order reference/name is S00022. The status bar now shows "Sales Order" as the active status (with "Quotation Sent" and "Quotation" in the history), and a "Create Invoice" button is visible — confirming the quotation has become a sales order.

Cancelled Sales Order S00022. The status bar now shows "Cancelled" as the active (checked) status, with "Sales Order", "Quotation Sent", and "Quotation" in the history. The order reference remains S00022.

(1) Customer 'fwod17-n2 Bench Customer' opened — Name: "fwod17-n2 Bench Customer", City: "Benchville" (both verified from live form fields). (2) Quotation S00022 opened — Reference: "S00022", Customer: "fwod17-n2 Bench Customer" (shown with city "Benchville" beside it), Status in status bar: "Cancelled" (checked/active radio), Untaxed Amount: "£ 3,750.00". All values read from the live form.
